summary: Single 80 mm diameter, 10 mm wide spoked wheel with a tire and six spokes. It has a central hub for a 3 mm D-shaft and six small mounting holes around the hub. The product is sold as a pair, and this describes one wheel with its axis along z.

mountingSurfaces.description: Outer hub face with the six mounting holes (one pair 12.7 mm apart, two pairs 19.1 mm apart) for #4/M3 screws or a universal mounting hub
Tire tread surface, which is the outer rolling contact surface (radius 40 mm)

notes: Overall size (80 mm diameter, 10 mm width), the 3 mm D-shaft fit, and the hole spacings (12.7 mm and 19.1 mm) come from the stated, unverified product data. The mounting hole diameter is assumed from the stated #4/M3 screw size. The hole positions are approximate: the 12.7 mm pair is placed on the x axis, and the two 19.1 mm pairs are placed at ±30° from it, which is an estimate from the images. The 6 spoke slots (M2/#2 screws) are not dimensioned and so are not listed as holes. The hub bore is modeled as 3 mm through, but the actual D-profile and hub depth are not visible. The tire is a separate part that fits over the rim, and no internal dimensions are given.
